Editor Eddie 1.0.0 — your AI-powered video editing assistant

- Initial release with fast, cloud-based video editing: upload footage, describe edits, and export polished videos in minutes.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM video files up to 500MB; includes basic audio and image track support.
- Automatic backend connection and session management, including anonymous 7-day trial tokens.
- Common edit actions: trim pauses, add transitions, export to 1080p MP4, preview timeline, check credits, and more.
- Clear error handling for file size, format, credits, and subscription issues.
- Designed for content creators seeking professional results without complex editing software.
